title: The grow lamps snap
text: A belt on the hydroponic lamps snaps. The beds will fail if nobody climbs in.

choices.label: Strip the workshop for a new belt

title: People at the gate
text: A crowd is at the yard gate with a story about a collapse north of Atlantic Av.

title: Charcoal beds clog
text: Mara says the air filters are pulling dust. Someone has to open the stacks.

choices.label: Shut a filter and clean it

title: A quarrel on the platform
text: Jonah and Owen are shouting about who ate the extra rations.

title: A sermon in the passage
text: Ellis is preaching the Synod's line by the filter room. A few of yours are listening.

title: A crate with no stamp
text: Fran can move a crate through Bowling Green. No receipt.

title: A rumble under the platform
text: Lila's dig crew hits a hollow. Dust pours into the lower level.

title: A voice in the static
text: June's radio, or a pipe that sounds like one, says a word twice: Floor.

title: Traders with sacks
text: Benny waves in a handcar from the Exchange side. The sacks of food are real. The price is not kind.

title: Two bunks are empty
text: Two residents walked into the tunnel toward the river. They left their tags.

title: Spare cable in the yard
text: Mara's crew pulls a spool of cable out of a sealed locker. It is Depot stock, forgotten.

title: A wet cough
text: Ruth and two others on the platform are coughing into their sleeves.

choices.label: Clear beds and lose a shift
Tell them to work through it

title: A drip over the bunks
text: Pete finds a drip over the bunks. It will be a stream if nobody patches it.

title: Hal will not sleep
text: Hal is walking the platform again. The night shift wants him off the tools.

choices.label: Give him a bench and a watch

title: Owen counts the bowls
text: Owen counts the bowls twice and says the kitchen is short a meal.

choices.label: Split the short meal across the room
Hold the line and promise tomorrow

title: Samira's drill walks off
text: Samira's drill is gone from the workshop peg. Someone borrowed it and did not bring it back.

title: Ada wants a curtain
text: Ada asks for a curtain between the bunks. It is a small thing, and the room is listening.

choices.label: Tell her the cloth is for filters

title: Nora tastes salt in the air
text: Nora tastes salt in the air by the east wall. The river is closer than the map says.

title: Vic's scrap pile
text: Vic has a pile of scrap that could be parts or could be a fight about who owns it.

title: Rob stays on the belt
text: Rob will not leave the belt. The next shift is standing there with their hands empty.

title: Tess starts a hymn
text: Tess starts a hymn in the passage. It is not the Synod's hymn. People join anyway.

choices.label: Ask for quiet on the platform

title: Paul's old route
text: Paul swears he can drive a handcar to the ferry the way he used to. The tunnel is not on your map.

choices.label: Send him with a lamp and a partner

title: The beds remember the belt
text: The hydroponic beds are still off their rhythm.

by.fix: The new belt holds. The beds are back, and the crew knows who climbed in for it.
by.lose: The lost crop is still the story at meals. The next belt looks thin.

choices.label: Thank the crew in front of the room

title: The gate, again
text: Someone from that crowd is back at the gate.

by.take: One of the people you took in has family still outside. They ask if the yard can stand one more.
by.turn: The people you turned away left a mark on the gate. A child is asking for them by name.

choices.label: Open the gate a little wider
Take the names and nothing else

title: Mara opens the stacks again
text: Mara is back at the charcoal.

by.clean: Mara's crew still talks about the shift they shut the filter to clean it. The dust is back.
by.run: Mara still tastes the dust from the week she left the filter running.

title: Jonah and Owen again
text: Jonah and Owen are not finished.

by.hear: Jonah and Owen kept the peace you made, until the bowls came up short again.
by.shut: Jonah and Owen are louder than last time. Sending them back to work did not end it.

choices.label: Sit them at the same table

title: Ellis asks for a room
text: Ellis wants a room for the talking.

by.allow: Ellis says the sermon you allowed needs a room now, not a passage.
by.stop: Ellis is quieter, and the people you pulled away from the sermon have not forgotten.

choices.label: Keep the hall for the yard

title: Fran has another crate
text: Fran is back with a price.

by.take: Fran says the crate you took opened a route. She can run it again, for a cut.
by.refuse: Fran tells the line you sent her crate back. The next offer is smaller, and colder.

title: Lila will not go back down
text: Lila is on the platform and will not take the ladder.

by.shore: Lila says the shore you built held. She still will not be the first one down.
by.push: Lila remembers being told to keep digging. She will not take the ladder.

choices.label: Keep her on the upper level

title: June hears it twice
text: June has the word again.

by.log: June brings the page you told her to keep. The voice said Floor a second time.
by.ignore: June heard it again, after you told her to ignore it. She wrote it down anyway.

title: Benny's traders come back
text: Benny's traders are at the handcar again.

by.buy: Benny's traders are back with more sacks, because you paid last time.
by.pass: Benny's traders are back. They remember that you let them pass, and the price has not improved.

title: A tag comes back
text: A tag from the empty bunks is in the yard.

by.search: The crew you sent comes back with one tag and no person. The other bunk is still empty.
by.let: Someone left a tag on the gate. It belongs to one of the two you let go.

choices.label: Hang the tag in the hall

title: Ruth's cough moves
text: Ruth's cough is in another room.

by.beds: The beds you cleared held Ruth. The cough is in the next bunk now.
by.work: Ruth worked through it, like you asked. Two more people are coughing.

title: Pete's drip is back
text: Pete is under the same pipe.

by.patch: Pete's patch held for a while. The drip has found a new seam.
by.buckets: The buckets Pete set are full. The bunks under them are not dry.
